headline: Amid Tax Reform Targeting High-Priced Homes, Gangnam and Seocho Home Prices Near Turning Point to Decline
summary: Home prices in Gangnam and Seocho, where high-priced homes are concentrated, are reportedly cooling rapidly. Possible downturns in sale and jeonse prices are being discussed.
why: Gangnam is Seoul's most expensive residential area, so price moves there are watched as a signal for the wider housing market.
